headline: On November 12, 2003: Shanghai Transrapid sets world speed record
captionCards: 501 km/h — fastest commercial rail speed ever recorded
Still holds the record for unmodified commercial rail vehicles
instagramCaption:
Shanghai Transrapid hits 501 km/h — fastest commercial rail ever.

The maglev train reached 501 km/h in 2003, a record that still stands for unmodified commercial rail vehicles. Operated by the Shanghai maglev line, it used technology from the Transrapid joint venture between Siemens and ThyssenKrupp. The test run occurred on the same track later used for passenger service.

It remains the benchmark for high-speed magnetic levitation trains worldwide.
